name: Flight of the Moth
source:
Imprisoned for unjust reasons, Cecilia's glimmer of hope comes in a form of a stranger who promises to help her to escape. Can she trust the stranger to help her out of her predicament?

[From [url=https://temteno.itch.io/flight-of-the-moth]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
塞西莉亚因不公正的原因被监禁，一名陌生人承诺帮助她越狱，她的一线希望由此而来。她能相信陌生人会帮助她摆脱困境吗？

[来自[url=https://temteno.itch.io/flight-of-the-moth]Itch.io[/url]]
